text: JUI-F leader Noor Alam Khan called for improving governance, revisiting the NFC Award and creating new provinces, saying the process should begin with Punjab, which holds the largest share of votes. He also stressed the need for power devolution through local governments.
translated_text: JUI-F 领导人努尔·阿拉姆·汗 (Noor Alam Khan) 呼吁改善治理、重新审视 NFC 奖并创建新的省份，并表示这一进程应从拥有最多选票的旁遮普邦开始。他还强调需要通过地方政府下放权力。

text: Parliamentarian Aasia Ishaq from MQM called for more administrative units in Pakistan, saying smaller provinces and a robust local government system are needed to improve governance and municipal services as the country’s population surpasses 260 million.@SDPIPakistan
translated_text: 来自 MQM 的议员 Aasia Ishaq 呼吁巴基斯坦建立更多的行政单位，并表示，随着该国人口超过 2.6 亿，需要较小的省份和强大的地方政府体系来改善治理和市政服务。@SDPIPakistan
